def quote(cache, sku, currency):
    return {"sku": sku, "currency": currency, "price": cache.price(sku, currency)}

files.tests/test_prices.py:
import unittest

from src.prices import PriceCache
from src.quotes import quote
from src.exports import export_price


class PriceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_same_currency_callers(self):
        cache = PriceCache({("widget", "USD"): 120, ("widget", "EUR"): 90})
        self.assertEqual(quote(cache, "widget", "USD"), {"sku": "widget", "currency": "USD", "price": 120})
        self.assertEqual(export_price(cache, "widget", "USD"), "USD,120")

    def test_zero_and_missing(self):
        cache = PriceCache({("free", "USD"): 0})
        self.assertEqual(cache.price("free", "USD"), 0)
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            cache.price("missing", "USD")
